trigger: Game start. Kitchen, morning. Carly comes in the back door.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Day three. Ninety-five by noon. The fridge quit Monday. The faucet coughs, then nothing. Wraith hears the gate first.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Ears up. One sharp bark. Tail going like a prop.]

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Hi. Hi, baby. Yes. I know. I smell like a server room.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Carly drops her headset bag on the counter. Seventy hours on the dispatch floor. She looks ten years older and very awake.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: They sent the day shift home. Generator's got maybe a week. The phones died Tuesday. We kept talking anyway.

choices.text: Sit. I'll get you some water.
What was it like in there?

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: It's warm as bathwater, isn't it. I don't care. Give it here.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Radio only. Calls from patrol cars. People walking in off the street to report things.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: A man walked six miles to tell us his wife died. He just wanted someone to write it down.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Address, time, name. Yeah. That's the job. You write it down so it happened.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Her hand is hot and steady. The shaking is somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Yerington's seventy miles of nothing. And I'm back on shift Thursday.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Braith. Somebody has to answer. Even if it's just a guy on a bike.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Water's out. Pressure dropped overnight. I'll haul from the marina and boil it.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Lolo came by. She's worried about Mr. Pruitt. His oxygen machine needs a plug.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: And Gil's running a generator like it's the Fourth of July. Somebody should ask him nicely.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: I'm going to sleep for four hours. Wake me if the world ends again.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She laughs once, into your shoulder, and goes upstairs. Wraith stays with you. She always does.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Looks at Carly. Looks at you. Sits on your boot. Decision made.]
